name: Glint Flick
description: Flick a fingertip to throw a bead of white light that stings the target's eyes and skin.

name: Palm Lumen
description: Cup a small steady light in the palm and keep it burning as the base for every stronger light move.

name: Flash Spark
description: Snap the fingers to burst a bright spark before the target's face and spoil their aim for a moment.

name: Bright Thread
description: Draw a thin hot thread of light across the gap and prick it into one spot on the target.

name: Shimmer Screen
description: Raise a thin sheet of shimmer before the chest that scatters the force of a weak strike.

name: Bright Leap
description: Throw a patch of light ahead and step into the brightness to close a short gap at once.

name: Even Glow
description: Hold one glow above the palm at a fixed brightness until the breath and the light keep the same time.

name: Lamp Palm
description: Press a warm bright palm on the target's arm so the held light scalds the skin.

name: Steady Beam
description: Hold a narrow beam on one spot of the target to drive them off that line and keep them back.

name: Level Gleam
description: Spread an even gleam round the user and watch for anything that moves inside it.

name: Calm Sheen
description: Wrap the body in a calm even sheen that dulls glancing blows and keeps its brightness while held.

name: Fixed Flare
description: Fire one flare of fixed size into a striker's face to break the rhythm of the attack.

name: Dawn Draw
description: Draw slow breath and pull pale light qi into the chest to warm the limbs and wake the muscles.

name: Morning Palm
description: Open the palm with a bright pulse behind it and push the target back a step.

name: First Ray
description: Loose one pale ray from the open hand that warms and stings wherever it lands.

name: Rising Glow
description: Lay a warm glowing hand on an ally's bruise to ease the ache and close shallow scrapes.

name: Daylight Hold
description: Stand in a column of steady daylight that takes the sting from blows aimed at the head and chest.

name: Eye Lumen
description: Let a gleam gather in the eyes to see clearly in dim places and note small movements.

name: Sight Thread
description: Cast a thin thread of light outward and read where it is blocked by a hidden body.

name: Clear Glare
description: Turn a hard glare on the target's eyes so they look away and lose the moment.

name: Pupil Flash
description: Flash light into the pupils of a charging foe so the charge falters and the aim drifts.

name: Keen Ray
description: Send a single keen ray from the eye line that pricks through cloth to the skin below.

name: Aim Lumen
description: Fix a point of light on the target so the user's next throw or blow finds its mark.

name: Squint Guard
description: Narrow the eyes against a flash and dip aside so a thrown missile slides past the face.

name: Prism Snap
description: Snap two fingers through a clear wedge of light that splits into three stinging beads.

name: Split Beam
description: Part one beam into a fan of thin beams that sting everyone in a short arc ahead.

name: Bend Ray
description: Curve a thin ray round the edge of a raised guard to touch the shoulder behind it.

name: Fan Shimmer
description: Fan the fingers to scatter coloured shimmer across the target's sight so edges seem to move.

name: Facet Guard
description: Hold the hand up as a faceted lens that turns a thrown missile off its line.

name: Fringe Sight
description: Read the coloured fringe at the edge of a light to tell where qi is being held.

name: Knit Glow
description: Lay both palms on an ally's wound and pour warm light through them until the flesh slowly knits.

name: Soft Radiance
description: Touch the user's own chest with a soft pulse of light that eases pain and steadies the heart.

name: Pain Lamp
description: Hold a faint lamp of light over an ally's sprain to dull the pain and bring down the swelling.

name: Warm Ward
description: Wrap an ally in warm light that dulls a glancing blow before it lands.

name: Sting Flash
description: Touch a foe with a hand full of sharp light for a short burning sting that buys a breath.

name: Rally Beam
description: Send a soft beam into an ally's chest to lift tired limbs and clear a dull head.

name: Flicker Step
description: Flicker from one footing to the next so quickly that the foe's eyes lag behind the body.

name: Swift Ray
description: Loose a ray so fast that the target sees the sting before the flash.

name: Streak Slip
description: Slip sideways along a streak of light to leave the line of a thrust.

name: Quickening
description: Pulse light through the legs and arms to quicken the next few steps and strikes.

name: Dart Gleam
description: Jab a fist forward on a gleam of speed that lands before the foe can raise a guard.

name: Halo Ward
description: Spread a ring of light round the head and shoulders that takes the weight from blows aimed there.

name: Polished Palm
description: Turn a polished palm of light to throw a small flash back at the one who threw it.

name: Flashing Plate
description: Raise a flat wall of hard light for one blow and let it fade at once.

name: Glare Shove
description: Push a wave of glare into a striker's face so the blow goes wide of the guard.

name: Lantern Sense
description: Hold a lantern of light at arm's length and feel what stands at its edge.

name: Radiant Brace
description: Brace the stance with a steady light that keeps the user's footing and nerve through a long guard.

name: Gleam Counter
description: Turn a blow aside on a flash of light and strike the open flank in the same motion.
